_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...you have failed... We will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.dst: Sus. Cüce yavrusu... başaramadın... Sessizce gitmeyeceğiz. UYAN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.src: {u}... Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.src: Return to Korzim on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire Resistance and the Staff of True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.dst: Amulet of Fire Resistance ve Staff of True Ice ile {p} şehrindeki büyücü dükkânının ikinci katında bulunan Korzim'e dön.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.src: The war is starting... and Axelus... He has not returned.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.dst: Savaş başlıyor... ve Axelus... Geri dönmedi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.src: We can not go... Not without him. Find him... And bring him to the... Dogun village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.dst: Gidemeyiz... Onsuz olmaz. Onu bul... Ve getir onu... Dogun köyüne.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.src: I can not leave. The guard...it is on high alert. He was last at {p}...yes?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.dst: Ben ayrılamam. Muhafızlar...alarm halinde. En son {p} şehrindeydi...değil mi?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.src: Head to {p} and look for Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.src: The first group has already started their climb, let's hurry.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.dst: İlk grup tırmanışa başladı bile, acele edelim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.speaker: Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.src: Hey! Everyone, the king has someone in the cage! It's been years since we used it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.dst: Hey! Millet, kral kafese birini koymuş! Kullanmayalı yıllar oldu!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.src: Wait, that's Axelus up there!! The king locked up his son?! What in the world?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.dst: Durun, yukarıdaki Axelus!! Kral kendi oğlunu mu hapsetmiş?! Bu da ne böyle?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.src: I heard he was consorting with demons, but that can't possibly be true, can it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.dst: Şeytanlarla iş birliği yaptığını duydum ama bu doğru olamaz, değil mi?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.src: For the last time, they are not demons!! Gods, I've been telling you this whole time! Not even my father will listen to reason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.dst: Son kez söylüyorum, onlar şeytan değil!! Tanrım, en başından beri bunu anlatıyorum! Babam bile laf dinlemiyor!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.src: If I don't get freed we're doomed, you hear me?! We won't survive another war! As your prince I demand to be freed!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.dst: Serbest bırakılmazsam hepimiz mahvoluruz, duydunuz mu?! Bir savaşı daha atlatamayız! Prensiniz olarak serbest bırakılmamı emrediyorum!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.src: Listen, the statues are climbable and there's a control panel for the lava siphons near them! Now help me so we all don't die!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.dst: Dinle, heykellere tırmanılabiliyor ve yanlarında lav sifonlarının kontrol paneli var! Şimdi yardım et de hepimiz ölmeyelim!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.src: Free Axelus and escape the city.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.src: Wait, that human just defaced the hero's monument!! Are they working with the demons too?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.dst: Durun, o insan kahramanın anıtını tahrip etti!! O da mı şeytanlarla iş birliği yapıyor?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.src: {u}! I didn't think you'd be back, but we need to leave, now! Meet me outside!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.dst: {u}! Geri döneceğini hiç sanmıyordum ama hemen gitmemiz lazım! Dışarıda buluşalım!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.src: {u}! Over here, to the right! By the cannon! I'm commandeering this thing.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.dst: {u}! Buraya, sağa! Topun yanına! Bu şeye el koyuyorum.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.src: We need to get up to the Doguns before the Dwarves begin their assault, or before the Doguns take their last resort.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.dst: Cüceler saldırıya geçmeden ya da Dogunlar son çarelerine başvurmadan önce Dogunların yanına çıkmamız lazım.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.src: Get in the cannon, now! You've got your armour, you might end up charred and covered in soot but you'll be fine!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.dst: Topa gir, hemen! Zırhın var, biraz kavrulup isle kaplanabilirsin ama bir şey olmaz!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.src: Don't tell anyone we shot ourselves out of a cannon, I'll never live it down. Now come on, to the Dogun village, hurry!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.dst: Kendimizi toptan fırlattığımızı kimseye söyleme, ömür boyu bunu yüzüme vururlar. Hadi, Dogun köyüne, acele et!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.src: If the Doguns are taking their last resort and summoning Garaheth, then we've got two sides to stop at once...basically, the odds are astronomically against us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.dst: Dogunlar son çarelerine başvurup Garaheth'i çağırıyorsa aynı anda iki tarafı durdurmamız gerekecek... yani şansımız neredeyse sıfır.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.src: That means you do what you need to do, no matter what. Understood? If we can stop this madness then the casualties won't have died for nothing! Now move!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.dst: Yani ne gerekiyorsa yapacaksın, ne olursa olsun. Anlaşıldı mı? Bu deliliği durdurabilirsek ölenler boşuna ölmemiş olur! Şimdi kımılda!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.src: Reach the portal and stop Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.src: I can't believe this... That bone was part of the ritual?! Agh, how could we have been so STUPID! You're all lucky we prepared for this!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.dst: İnanamıyorum... O kemik ritüelin bir parçası mıydı?! Ah, nasıl bu kadar APTAL olabildik! Buna hazırlıklı olduğumuz için şanslısınız!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.src: You need to get inside him. He's still chained! The amulet will protect you from the heat! Freeze him from the inside out!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.dst: İçine girmen lazım. Hâlâ zincirli! Tılsım seni sıcaktan koruyacak! Onu içeriden dışarıya dondur!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.src: Find all {~} organs and destroy them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.dst: {~} organın hepsini bul ve yok et.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.src: Leave Garaheth and exit his realm.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.dst: Garaheth'ten ayrıl ve onun diyarından çık.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.src: EVERYONE, STOP THIS! RIGHT NOW!! IT'S OVER!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.src: Open your eyes for once in your lives!! You see that?! Behind me! THAT was going to be the end result!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.dst: Hayatınızda bir kez olsun gözünüzü açın!! Gördünüz mü?! Arkamda! İŞTE sonuç bu olacaktı!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.src: Garaheth would have killed every one of us, damn it! Are you that short-sighted that you can't see this?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.dst: Garaheth hepimizi öldürecekti, kahretsin! Bunu göremeyecek kadar mı dar görüşlüsünüz?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.src: Everyone here is to blame, except the human who helped stop this! The Doguns were already exiled, they wouldn't have hurt anyone!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.dst: Bunu durdurmaya yardım eden insan dışında buradaki herkes suçlu! Dogunlar zaten sürgündeydi, kimseye zarar vermeyeceklerdi!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.src: But we couldn't just let ANYTHING be! You always need more glory, more, more, MORE! Don't you, Draani? I'm ashamed to be your lineage!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.dst: Ama biz HİÇBİR ŞEYİ öylece bırakamadık! Hep daha fazla şan, daha fazla, daha, DAHA! Değil mi, Draani? Senin soyundan geldiğim için utanıyorum!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.src: And you, Doguns! I...I pitied you. You were wronged, but you resort to this? You'd doom the world over to spite the Dwarves? Is that it?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.dst: Ya siz, Dogunlar! Ben...size acıdım. Size haksızlık edildi, ama başvurduğunuz yol bu mu? Cücelere inat bütün dünyayı yok mu edecektiniz? Mesele bu mu?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.src: Whelp. You do not understand. To be persecuted...and see your people tortured...hunted.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.dst: Yavru. Anlamıyorsun. Zulüm görmek...halkının işkence görüşünü...avlanışını izlemek.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.src: You all deserve it! You attacked our ancestors for sport! Eye for an eye, have you heard of it? It's only fair!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.dst: Hepiniz bunu hak ettiniz! Atalarımıza eğlence olsun diye saldırdınız! Göze göz, hiç duydun mu? Bu adalet!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.speaker: Dwarven Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.src: Imbeciles...your stories are not true. We... We lived through the war. You took everything...and suffered none.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.dst: Ahmaklar...hikâyeleriniz doğru değil. Biz... Biz o savaşı yaşadık. Her şeyi aldınız...ve hiç acı çekmediniz.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.src: I've been trying to tell BOTH of you that the monarchy has been spreading lies for centuries! One bad king doesn't mean the whole species is a loss!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.dst: İkinize de krallığın yüzyıllardır yalan yaydığını anlatmaya çalışıyorum! Tek bir kötü kral yüzünden bütün bir ırk kötü sayılmaz!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.src: Shut your mouth. Even now...you trample on the bones of our god... You have taken everything from us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.dst: Kapa çeneni. Şimdi bile...tanrımızın kemiklerini çiğniyorsunuz... Bizden her şeyi aldınız...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.src: This earth is stained by you. We...we shall burn you...and scatter your ash to the wind.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.dst: Bu toprak sizin yüzünüzden lekelendi. Biz...sizi yakacağız...ve külünüzü rüzgâra savuracağız.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.src: DON'T YOU DARE! STOP, RIGHT NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.src: You would... You would kill a savior...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.dst: Bir kurtarıcıyı... Bir kurtarıcıyı mı öldürürsünüz...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.src: No, no! No no no, this can't be happening! H-Hang on, we'll save you, I...I'll do something, I...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.dst: Hayır, hayır! Hayır hayır hayır, bu olamaz! D-Dayan, seni kurtaracağız, ben...ben bir şey yapacağım, ben...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.src: Y-You DEMONS! MONSTERS! I'll avenge you, Axelus, j-just give me time-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.dst: S-Sizi ŞEYTANLAR! CANAVARLAR! Öcünü alacağım Axelus, s-sadece bana zaman ver-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.src: AGH, SHUT UP! SHUT...ack... Q-Quiet. Listen to one damn word from my mouth, Draani... For once in your miserable life
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.dst: AH, KES SESİNİ! KES...ıh... S-Sus. Ağzımdan çıkan tek bir lanet kelimeyi dinle, Draani... Şu sefil hayatında bir kez olsun
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.src: Tell. The. TRUTH!! G-gaagh...you know that's th...the only way to stop this. Swallow your pride, you...old fool...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.dst: Gerçeği. Söyle. ARTIK!! G-gaagh...biliyorsun bu...bunu durdurmanın tek yolu bu. Gururunu yut, seni...yaşlı aptal...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.src: I...I... Axelus... He...he called me Draani...why did...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.src: Men, stand down. This... This war is over! I will not have one more life lost! Touch the Doguns and I'll personally behead you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.dst: Askerler, geri çekilin. Bu... Bu savaş bitti! Bir can daha kaybedilmesine izin vermeyeceğim! Dogunlara dokunan olursa kafasını kendi ellerimle keserim!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.src: Chief, I...I ask of you but an hour of your time. If you are willing to negotiate...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.dst: Reis, ben...senden yalnızca bir saatini istiyorum. Müzakereye razıysan...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.src: Speak with the King of {p} and the Dogun Chieftain.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.dst: {p} Kralı ve Dogun Reisi ile konuş.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.src: Ah, you've arrived. I...actually remember you from earlier. So you and...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.dst: Ah, geldin. Ben...aslında seni daha önceden hatırlıyorum. Demek sen ve...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.src: ...you knew my son. Were helping him try to put an end to this, before everything was too far gone. Heh...apologies, for that.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.dst: ...oğlumu tanıyordun. Her şey iş işten geçmeden buna bir son vermesine yardım ediyordun. Heh...bunun için özür dilerim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.src: Paku and I have had a long discussion about the wisdom of youth over the old. You all were right. I needed to swallow my pride.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.dst: Paku ile gençliğin yaşlılığa karşı bilgeliği üzerine uzun uzun konuştuk. Hepiniz haklıydınız. Gururumu yutmam gerekiyordu.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.src: We agreed upon a peace treaty... A new city... The Dwarves will aid us in building it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.dst: Bir barış antlaşmasında anlaştık... Yeni bir şehir... Cüceler onu kurmamıza yardım edecek.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.src: All hostilities...will end. My people will...be free to roam the caverns. It has been...too long.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.dst: Bütün düşmanlıklar...sona erecek. Halkım...mağaralarda özgürce dolaşabilecek. Çok...uzun zaman oldu.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.src: And the entombed Doguns at Courag will be reconstituted, as well, supposing that is a possibility.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.dst: Courag'da gömülü Dogunlar da, eğer mümkünse, yeniden canlandırılacak.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.src: Every king, since my so-far-great grandfather, Draani Thunderwill, has battled with their morality over the lies told to my people.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.dst: Büyük büyük dedem Draani Thunderwill'den beri her kral, halkıma söylenen yalanlar yüzünden vicdanıyla savaştı.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.src: It ends here, with the name Draani VIII. It will take time, but the bloodshed has proven things must begin to change now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.dst: Bu iş burada, Draani VIII adıyla bitiyor. Zaman alacak ama dökülen kan, değişimin hemen başlaması gerektiğini gösterdi.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.src: You and the coalition have saved the Heights, and Gavel. In {p}, you will find a stall to trade valuable minerals. You will be granted special Dwarven privileges to purchase it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.dst: Sen ve koalisyon Heights'ı ve Gavel'ı kurtardınız. {p} şehrinde değerli mineral takas edilen bir tezgâh bulacaksın. Artık oradan alışveriş yapman için sana özel Cüce ayrıcalıkları tanınacak.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.src: Though that is...almost certainly not enough a reward for everything you have done...sincerely. Thank you, Wynn soldier.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.dst: Gerçi bu...yaptığın her şeyin karşılığı olarak neredeyse kesinlikle yetersiz...içtenlikle. Teşekkür ederim, Wynn askeri.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#068.src: Return to Korzim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire and the Staff of Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#068.dst: Amulet of Fire ve Staff of Ice ile {p} şehrindeki büyücü dükkânının ikinci katında [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Korzim'e dön.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#069.src: Reach the ritual colosseum and prevent Garaheth from being summoned
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#069.dst: Ritüel arenasına ulaş ve Garaheth'in çağrılmasını engelle

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#070.src: Freeze any vital point of Garaheth you can find!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#070.dst: Garaheth'in bulabildiğin her hayati noktasını dondur!

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#072.src: We...we have nothing left... We could have...taken them with us... Now they will...will... You...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#072.dst: Biz...bizim hiçbir şeyimiz kalmadı... Onları da...yanımızda götürebilirdik... Şimdi onlar...onlar... Sen...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#072.speaker: Dogun Chieftain
